name: Saltwall After Dark
description: A serialized neural-feed crime drama in which players inhabit rotating cast members of a Shelf-based runner crew operating out of the Saltwall district — fences, fixers, and couriers navigating debts to three competing corponation enforcers. Each episode is told from a different crew member's body, meaning loyalty and betrayal feel physiologically real. Season 4 introduced a Tier 3 corporate auditor who goes native, becoming the show's most-downloaded perspective.
cultural_impact: Popularized the term 'perspective debt' — the emotional residue of inhabiting a dying character's final neural feed — which entered common Shelf slang by 2194.
story_hooks: A player character's perspective feed from Season 2 is discovered to contain an unlicensed real memory — someone actually died during production and their final moments were edited into the episode.
An Axiom enforcer recognizes his own face in a Season 5 villain and begins investigating who sold his biometric data to the production team.
A runner crew on the actual Saltwall uses the show's broadcast schedules to time their operations, knowing enforcement patrols thin out when the episode drops.
